content.title: 4-1-3-2. Applicability.
content.summary: A.	This Division shall apply to all construction in the City that disturbs 10,000 square feet or more of land surface. Water quality standards and detention apply to all new development and redevelopment that disturbs one acre or more.

faqs.a:
A.	This Division shall apply to all construction in the City that disturbs 10,000 square feet or more of land surface. Water quality standards and detention apply to all new development and redevelopment that disturbs one acre or more. Erosion control shall apply to all land and efforts to prevent, mitigate, and control accelerated soil erosion and shall include the design, installation, and implementation of temporary erosion control measures prior to any earth disturbance activities.
(Ord. No. 4867, § 2, 2-12-2024)
